messages:
Hiro: Rolling out OnPrem Telemetry Consent Clarifications v1 tonight. This clarifies consent recording, adds a masked-metrics mode, and a lightweight audit-webhook option for customers that want their own copy of consent events. Window and quick prep below. Ping with any legal or customer-experience concerns.
release-bot: Artifact pushed: onprem-telemetry-clarify@v1 -> s3://internal-releases/onprem-telemetry/clarify/v1. Rollout window: 2025-12-08 23:30 UTC -> 2025-12-09 02:30 UTC. Canary: 7% first 45m.
Nadine: Quick Q  what is "masked-metrics"?
Hiro: Masked-metrics mode strips metric keys to a stable prefix and replaces variable segments with consistent hashes before leaving the tenant boundary. This reduces fingerprinting risk while preserving aggregate utility. It is opt-in per-tenant.
legal-team: Note for gov customers: masked-metrics alone may not satisfy some attestations. For those customers we will require signed consent artifacts + local HSM signing. Please route gov requests to Legal for review.
ops-bot: Canary health checks green (no regressions). Note: this release introduces a small management port change for customers who enable the audit-webhook: management listens on TCP/15014 for webhook handshake traffic (runtime still on 15011).
support-oncall: Coverage: @Nadine and @Hiro for the window. Backup: @Sam. If a customer reports missing consent events, escalate to #eng-runtime immediately.
Hiro: Short customer-readiness checklist:
- Decide whether to enable masked-metrics or full-metrics.
- If enabling audit-webhook, ensure firewall allows outbound HTTPS and accept webhook handshake on your side. Management port TCP/15014 is used for webhook handshakes only.
- For local-signing flows, provide KMS/HSM credentials and CA thumbprint.
- Run the new consent preflight and attach results to the ticket.
API snippet to create a tenant consent record (v2 API):
```
curl -X POST https://mgmt.customer.example/api/v2/tenants/321/consent -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"consent":true, "mode":"masked-metrics", "webhook":"https://hooks.customer.example/consent"}'
```
Nadine: Any data-retention defaults?
Hiro: Defaults: masked-metrics retention = 45 days, full-metrics retention = 14 days. Audit-webhook events are sent immediately and not stored by default unless customer requests it.
legal-team: We'll publish a short guidance doc for contract teams and a checklist for gov/regulated customers.
Hiro: I'll post customer-facing FAQ and email templates after this thread. Monitoring is active for 6 hours post-rollout. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
